attributes.action: Reduce Employment Tribunal delays and improve legal support for workers
attributes.additional_details: Improve access to justice for workers whose employment rights may have been breached. Reduce Employment Tribunal delays and strengthen legal support for workers enforcing statutory rights. Workers may face employers with substantial financial resources, HR departments and experienced legal teams. Employment laws should provide meaningful protection in practice, with workers able to challenge alleged breaches fairly and without waiting years for their case to be heard.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to reduce Employment Tribunal waiting times and improve access to affordable or publicly funded legal advice and representation for workers who cannot afford to pay for it.

rejection.details:
We already have an open petition which is very similar to yours, which you may wish to sign:
'Provide funding to increase capacity for employment tribunal hearings'
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/777100


We could also accept a petition calling for financial support for legal advice as long as it was clear what kind of support and in what circumstances you would like to see this. Please submit a new petition if so.
